info.title: Zillow MLS Data Universal API
info.description: Bridge-hosted Zillow MLS and OData data access. Requires a Bridge account and approved datasets.

get.description: Retrieves a specific agent from Zillow MLS Data.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: dataset
parameters.description: Bridge dataset code that contains the agent.

parameters.name: agentId
parameters.description: Agent identifier from the Bridge dataset.

schema.description: Agent identifier from the Bridge dataset.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.
